narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The angle at V is marked thirty, so angle V is thirty degrees.
<bookmark mark='half'/>Thirty is only the part on one side of the diagonal.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The whole corner at V has two such parts.

narration: <bookmark mark='sum'/>To check, add the four angles of each shape. Each total should be three hundred sixty.
<bookmark mark='opp'/>Then see that opposite angles in every shape came out equal.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the tile shop and the answer card; two check lines: the four angles of each shape add up to 360°; opposite angles match

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says angle V is thirty degrees, the same as the angle beside the diagonal. The diagonal of a rhombus cuts angle V into two equal halves, so the whole angle is sixty.
